user.title: Daily Hadith setup
user.description: Enter your Sunnah.com API key for a fresh random hadith every day. Leave it empty to use the shared hadith of the day instead.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Request one from Sunnah.com on GitHub (sunnah-com/api).

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Add, change or clear your Sunnah.com API key. Leave it empty to use the shared hadith of the day.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Request one from Sunnah.com on GitHub (sunnah-com/api).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Sunnah.com. Try again later, or leave the key empty.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Daily Hadith is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

reload.name: Fetch new hadith
reload.description: Fetches a new hadith now. With an API key you get a new random hadith; without one, the latest hadith of the day.
